name: Global Pre-Engagement
description: Operational reminders to satisfy before active testing. Not a gate; just a checklist.

items.guidance: Secure written, legally binding permission from the target system owner.
Explicitly document included and excluded IP addresses, hostnames, domains, and sensitive systems.
Exchange secondary, out-of-band communication lines for urgent or critical incidents.
Confirm exact dates and time blocks allocated for active, aggressive testing.
Ensure testing-team infrastructure IPs are whitelisted on perimeter defences if using a grey-box approach.
Align on how sensitive data, findings, and temporary credentials are stored and deleted post-engagement.
